method: fitted, not clicked: `npm run rooms:panel` fits a line to each straight run of the floor's gold perimeter trim. This panel draws that trim only on the two front slab edges — the back wall bases carry no trim, only a soft shadow seam occluded by the leaning furniture — so the back runs are declared absent and no corners exist.
confidence: front runs good to ~0.14 px rms over 235-243 samples each. frontLeft slope 0.50763 is 1.5% from the runtime's +0.5; frontRight slope -0.55741 is 11.5% from -0.5 — so the panel disagrees with the runtime frame by ~11% on at least one edge, and with only two fitted runs the parallel-projection test cannot even be completed. Look-only reference; the arena polygon owns the geometry.

backLeft.absent: no trim drawn: the wall base is a soft shadow seam behind the shield rack and stools

backRight.absent: no trim drawn: the wall base is a soft shadow seam behind the chest, table and shield
